data.name: Ahzar
data.gender_notes: Ahzar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ahzar is derived from the Arabic word 'ahdar' or 'hazra' meaning green, flourishing, or blooming. It symbolizes freshness, prosperity, and growth. The name Ahzar carries the meaning “Green, flourishing, blooming” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahzar usually hope their child will grow to embody green, flourishing, blooming and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, green is considered a sacred color symbolizing paradise and prosperity. The name Ahzar could be associated with the concept of a flourishing or blooming garden in Jannah (Paradise).
data.etymology: Ahzar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Green, flourishing, blooming.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahzar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
